OpenSpec added negligible value on this trivial story (coordinator predicted this). No overlap between agents. However, a key discrepancy exists: Speckit claims it modified AC2 to remove implementation-prescribing language, yet acceptanceChanged is false — the AC text may still contain 'updated to match the new value'.
